messages:
Liz: Heads up — audit spotted `ingest-worker` service account decrypting a customer KMS key it should NOT have access to. Found during routine spot-check.
Omar: Which key/entry? link to the log?
Liz: `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/customer-data/cryptoKeys/customer-data-prod` — log shows `Decrypt` at 2026-03-20T13:02:11Z by sa:ingest-worker@redwood-prod. Stacktrace points to role-sync applying bindings in last deploy.
Michael: I shipped the RBAC refactor PR this morning (rollout at ~12:45). I updated role mapping to simplify serviceAccount selectors — could have been too permissive.
Tia: Do we know whether data was actually read or only decrypt attempts occurred?
Liz: Audit shows subsequent S3 GETs by the same principal at 2026-03-20T13:03:05Z — looks like actual object fetch. Snippet:
```
{"time":"2026-03-20T13:03:05Z","principal":"sa:ingest-worker@redwood-prod","action":"s3:GetObject","object":"s3://customer-ctl-123/prod/events/evt-0001.json"}
```
Omar: Immediate mitigations: 1) add a denylist in role-sync to block `ingest-worker` from being mapped to `data-reader`; 2) revoke current tokens/keys for that SA; 3) rollback the RBAC change if confirmed.
Michael: I'll revert the RBAC mapping PR now. Deploying rollback in ~5m. Do we also need to rotate KMS or revoke keys?
Tia: Revoke ephemeral tokens first: `kubectl -n prod delete secret ingest-worker-token` and disable any long-lived SA keys: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=ingest-worker@redwood-prod`.
security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 — severity P1. Pager duty on-call notified.
Liz: Containment plan (short): 1) rollback mapping (Michael) 2) push role-sync denylist + revoke SA creds (Omar) 3) start KMS staged rotation and re-encrypt at rest (Tia) 4) notify SOC + affected customers (me) 5) postmortem and CI guard rails. Assigning owners now.
Omar: Pushing denylist to role-sync repo and will add a temporary webhook to block unintended mappings. Also adding an audit alert for KMS Decrypts by principals not in `customers/*` allowlist.
Michael: Rollback merged and deployed. Confirmed bindings reverted to previous state. No new decrypt events observed in the last 4m.
Tia: KMS rotation started (staged rewrap). ETA ~40m to complete key promotion and re-encryption tasks.
security-bot: SOC update: affected customers flagged: ctl-123, ctl-789. Legal and CS looped in.
Liz: Good work. Keep all updates here. After containment, we need a postmortem + action items: stricter RBAC diff review, CI smoke tests that validate effective permissions, and an automated canary for cross-tenant decrypt events.
Omar: I'll follow up with PR for RBAC lint rule that fails CI on broad SA selector usage.
Michael: Sorry — will add extra approval steps for security-sensitive mapping changes."
